name: novomcp-word-sideload
description: NovoMCP Word add-in (sideload) — configurable engine URL, manifest-sideload distribution. Drop molecular intelligence into Word documents; ADMET / compliance / compute lookups for SMILES in your manuscript.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:manifest
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../novomcp-word-sideload-package.zip .
